owner_instruction_summary: Proceed to build and place a GTC order for JPM.
why_blocked: A JPM limit/GTC paper order can persist beyond one trading day. A buy limit above current/reclaim levels can execute immediately when marketable, and a buy limit below current price has different intent. Current WF67 support does not include stop-limit/reclaim-trigger orders, so Veritas must not invent a side, size, or limit price.
next_owner_input_needed: Provide exact paper order terms, e.g. 'JPM paper buy 1 share limit GTC at $___, max loss $___.'
